verdict.rationale: Alloy's own docs say workflows can run on a schedule as Portfolio workflows, and that transaction monitoring can run at scheduled times. So scheduled execution is a first-party capability. The evidence is two brief mentions with no detail on recurrence configuration. missing for 10: documentation of how recurring schedules and cadence are configured, API or programmatic management of schedules, explicit confirmation that schedules recur rather than run once, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Workflows can run in real time as part of a Journey evaluating an incoming application, or on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity
